about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a computer engineering student who enjoys the space where algorithms meet well-designed software.
about.p2: My background is in C/C++, data structures, graph theory and functional programming — especially Haskell. I like analysing a problem carefully, then building a fast, clean solution for it. Lately I've been applying this to Android development with Kotlin.
about.p3: I'm looking for an internship or junior role where I can contribute to scalable, high-performance software in a team-oriented environment.
